title: cinchona scrobiculata var. delondriana
intro: Cinchona scrobiculata var. delondriana, commonly known as the Yellow Cinchona, is a rare and lesser-known variety of the Cinchona tree, native to the tropical forests of the Western Ghats in India. This plant has been traditionally used in Ayurvedic medicine to treat various health conditions, including fever, malaria, and respiratory issues, due to its numerous health benefits. The therapeutic actions of the Yellow Cinchona include anti-inflammatory, antimalarial, and antimicrobial properties, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents such as quinine, cinchonine, and cinchonidine. The bioactive constituents of the Yellow Cinchona are responsible for its medicinal properties, making it a valuable resource in traditional medicine.
